notes.title: Huge 4.0 Update with major changes!
notes.notes:
Change Log for Just Drive A Lil. Build Version 4.0

-Minor Bug Fixes
-Added features.

-Fix Pause Menu Sprite
-Changed button animations on all menus
-Added text animation to Race Track Titles
-Added New 3rd Person Camera Angle (Follows tightly behind player)
-Created Track Intro Feed videos to play in the beginning of each race. (gives a quick preview of the track)
-Fixed Controller support for Xbox One Controller. Fixed jittering bug when interacting with certain controls.
 -Pause
 -Reset
 -Camera Switcher
 -Reset Unlocked tracks (Main Menu.)
  -Press corresponding button, then restart game.
-Added Rainbow flash effect to "New track unlocked" text.
-Added Countdown Timer to "Race end panel".
-Removed Extra track line in Proxy's Race Way that resulted in Texture clipping.
-Added Extra barriers for Proxy's Race way.
-Removed harsh color shine from various object colors
-Resized overhang objects by Swinging Door (3x) obstacles.
-Added Race Qualifying Audio for race Results
 -Separate and multiple audio clips for 1st, 2nd, 3rd and not qualifying places.
-Added "Wrong Way Warning" Detection in game.
-Added a Last Lap visual Indicator with animation, as well as sound, to indicate when the play has reached the final lap.
-Replaced See Through Doors Obstacle with Rotary Arms in Proxy's Raceway.
-Replaced See Through Doors Obstacle with Rotary Arms and Swinging Mallets in Cairo Speedway.
-Removed unwanted curved fence objects in Cairo Speedway.
-Removed unwanted curved fence objects in Elin Riverway.
-Added Rotary Arms Obstacle in Autumn Alley.
-Repositioned camera directly on the race track for the Thanks For Playing Scene.
-Replaced Proxy Character Model in Proxy's Raceway.
-Replaced Proxy Character Model in Cairo Speedway.
-Replaced Proxy and other Male and Female Characters Models in Elin Riverway.
-Replaced Proxy and other Male and Female Characters Models in Shape City Speedway.
-Replaced Proxy Character Model in Sogal Town.
-Replaced Proxy Character Model in Pumpkin Row.
-Added Proxy Character Model in Autumn Alley.
-Replaced Proxy Character Model in Snow Valley.
-Replaced Countdown, Pause, and "Welcome to..." audio quips on various race tracks to sound more clear.
-Lowered Music audio in all 8 race tracks for better sound balance.
-Added Last Lap Audio when entering the last lap.
-Added additional voice quips to pause menu.
-Made song for Proxy's Raceway Loopable
-Added new song for Main Menu.
-Replaced Proxy's picture in the About panel to a new updated version of Proxy.
-Replaced Game intro for the beginning of the game.
-Removed Proxy's character model from Thanks for Playing screen.
-Rearranged text positions in Thanks for Playing screen and added text animations.
-Repositioned Game Logo on  Main Menu Splash Screen.
-Updated Default Game Icon.

notes.title: New game release coming soon!!
notes.notes:
Announcing our newest game to be release in just 1 more day - Just Drive a Lil: It's a Mini Racing Game!! We are so excited for this release on Steam, as it IS our first one! The game will be released September 30th at 4PM PST (6PM CST). Go add this game to your wishlist if you haven't already and be one of the first ones to try the game out! 

We hope you enjoy the races this weekend and be sure to leave a review for us on our Steam page! [previewyoutube=xfHnzqs8xLQ;full][/previewyoutube]
